Header.description: LiDAR Object Header â€“ Standard OSD-LIO-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this LiDAR Object is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this LiDAR Object is or is intended to be located.

LiDARObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this LiDAR Object.

LiDARObjectTime.description: Time this LiDAR Object was produced.

LiDARObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this LiDAR Object is located.

ParentLiDARObjectIDs.description: IDs of LiDAR Objects at a preceding time step that spawned this object. Empty if the object has no known parent at a previous time step.

BasicLiDARObjectCount.description: Number of Basic LiDAR Objects contained in this LiDAR Object.

BasicLiDARObjects.description: Set of Basic LiDAR Objects contained in this LiDAR Object.

BasicLiDARObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Basic LiDAR Object is located within the containing LiDAR Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

BLObjectIDOrBLObject.description: Either the ID of a Basic LiDAR Object or the Basic LiDAR Object itself.

SubLiDARObjectCount.description: Number of child LiDAR Objects contained in this LiDAR Object.

SubLiDARObjects.description: Set of child LiDAR Objects contained in this LiDAR Object.

SubLiDARObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this child LiDAR Object is located within the containing LiDAR Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

SubLObjectIDOrSubLObject.description: Either the ID of a child LiDAR Object or the child LiDAR Object itself.

BLObjectOrLObject.description: A mixed array of Basic LiDAR Objects and child LiDAR Objects contained in this LiDAR Object.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this LiDAR Object in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the LiDAR Object (plain text, max 2048 characters).
